title: Biz, siz, ular
hook_voice: Lesson seven. We are, you are, they are.

example.en: We are students. They are teachers.

end_say: Saqlab qo'ying! Ertaga sakkizinchi dars: inkor gaplar.
caption:
0 dan ingliz tili, 7-dars: inglizcha «We are, You are, They are».

We are friends — Biz do'stmiz
You are students — Sizlar talabasiz
They are happy — Ular xursand

We, you, they — uchalasidan keyin ham doim "are" keladi.
Saqlab qo'ying va ingliz tilini boshlamoqchi bo'lgan do'stingizga yuboring.
Ertaga 8-dars: Inkor gaplar.
